title: Qwen Image 2.1 text to image
description: Local text-to-image workflow using the installed Qwen Image 2.1 INT8 conversion. The exact graph has produced a verified 1024×1024 PNG on the currently qualified local ComfyUI 0.37.0 worker; catalogue readiness checks required node and model filenames, not model hashes or the ComfyUI version.

evidence: Converted from image_qwen_image_2_1_t2i.json in the installed comfyui-workflow-templates-json 0.1.92 package with src/workflow/ui-to-api.ts against the live ComfyUI 0.37.0 object_info inventory. Installed source SHA-256: d33a6b36d530756e26ef4e25beb17d950daaea09d295475cd65f97f5d0af3b41. Qualified packaged API graph SHA-256 (UTF-8 with LF line endings): 56820925cb5999068f70e1e0c04af040b235acb41e610d78b97fe1b46cdd7dd7.

Direct local ComfyUI preflight on 2026-10-17 used the exact packaged graph, prompt seed 20261017, 25 steps, 1:1 at 1 megapixel. It succeeded in 50.603 seconds and produced a 1024×1024 PNG (1,134,614 bytes; SHA-256 042d9d86a4596a051ade4daaa3da3b77c497d7d228d581046704b8366570e686). This is one functional qualification, not a quality benchmark, offline guarantee, memory measurement or commercial-use authorization.
